svg.title: Inspect dependencies before changing automation
svg.desc: An update trigger connects to the suspect stitch and unintended reboot action. Check all shared references and targets before a scoped correction. Retain updates and validate subsequent events and business services. Arrows show automation dependencies, not network traffic.

g.text: Find the action. Check its reach. Correct narrowly.
Arrows represent automation dependencies, not packet paths.
Remove only the confirmed unintended execution path
VERIFY: updates continue + no recurrence + business services healthy
Other stitches and device targets are not inventoried here; inspect the real configuration.
Conceptual correction plan. No device execution or measured outcome is depicted.
